import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { cancelApp, confirmApp, previewApp } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/reroll/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const buildUsageMd = () => {
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('使用方法:');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/换词 功法ID');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/换词 功法ID 词条名');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/确认换词 功法ID');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/取消换词');

  return md;
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?取消换词$/.test(text)) {
    const result = await cancelApp({ bid, uid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.success ? result.message : `❌ ${result.message}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法换词', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const confirmMatch = text.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?确认换词\s+(\d+)$/);

  if (confirmMatch) {
    const skillBookId = Number(confirmMatch[2]);
    const result = await confirmApp({ bid, uid, skillBookId, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.success ? result.message : `❌ ${result.message}`);
    if (result.success && result.pending) {
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`功法：【${result.pending.skillBookName}】【${result.pending.gradeName}】【${result.pending.realmName}】`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`已替换：${result.pending.sourceLabel} -> ${result.pending.targetLabel}`);
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '功法换词',
        content: md,
        footer: result.success ? [{ label: '查看功法', command: `/查看功法 ${skillBookId}` }] : undefined
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const rerollText = text.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?换词\s*/, '').trim();
  const args = rerollText ? rerollText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];

  if (!skillBookIdStr) {
    const md = buildUsageMd();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法换词', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const skillBookId = Number(skillBookIdStr);

  if (!Number.isFinite(skillBookId) || skillBookId <= 0) {
    const md = buildUsageMd();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法换词', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const attrLabel = args.slice(1).join('').trim() || undefined;
  const result = await previewApp({ bid, uid, skillBookId, attrLabel, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!result.success) {
    md.addText(`❌ ${result.message}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法换词', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.mode === 'list') {
    md.addBold('换词');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`功法：【${result.skillBook.name}】【${result.skillBook.grade}】【${result.skillBook.realm}】`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`当前持有：换词符 ${result.ownedCount} 张`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('可替换词条');
    md.addNewline();

    for (const attr of result.availableAttrs) {
      md.addBlockquote(
        addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${attr.label}：${attr.currentText} / 上限 ${attr.maxText}`), [
          { label: attr.label, command: `/换词 ${skillBookId} ${attr.label}` }
        ])
      );

      md.addNewline();
    }

    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('目标词条优先从当前为0的词条中抽取，已激活词条概率较低'));

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法换词', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const pending = result.pending;

  md.addBold('换词预览');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`功法：【${pending.skillBookName}】【${pending.gradeName}】【${pending.realmName}】`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('消耗：换词符×1（取消不返还）');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`替换词条：${pending.sourceLabel} -> ${pending.targetLabel}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`目标池：${pending.targetPool === 'zero' ? '未激活词条池' : '已激活词条池'}`);
  md.addNewline();
  if (pending.targetWasActive) {
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('注意：目标词条当前已存在，确认后已激活词条数量会减少1条'));
  }
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`替换前：${pending.sourceLabel} ${pending.sourceCurrentText} / 上限 ${pending.sourceMaxText}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`替换后：${pending.targetLabel} ${pending.targetCurrentText} / 上限 ${pending.targetMaxText}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`确认指令：/确认换词 ${skillBookId}`);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '功法换词',
      content: md,
      footer: [
        { label: '确认', command: `/确认换词 ${skillBookId}` },
        { label: '取消', command: '/取消换词' }
      ]
    })
  );
});
